LACONIC.definition: Using very few words; expressing a great deal in brief, spare form.
LACONIC.example: He gave a laconic nod and said nothing more.

LOCI.gloss: plural of locus; particular places or centers
LOCI.definition: Plural of locus: particular positions, points, or centers where something occurs.
LOCI.example: The loci of the outbreak were traced to three markets.

CONICAL.definition: Having the shape of a cone; tapering evenly to a point.
CONICAL.example: The lamp threw a conical beam across the floor.

CALICO.definition: A plain-woven cotton fabric, typically printed with a bright pattern; also used of a cat with a multicolored coat.
CALICO.example: She wore a faded calico apron.

CONIC.gloss: of or relating to a cone
CONIC.definition: Of, relating to, or resembling a cone; in geometry, describing curves formed by slicing a cone.
CONIC.example: The ellipse is a conic section.

LION.definition: A large tawny-colored wild cat native to Africa and India, the male having a shaggy mane.

ION.definition: An atom or molecule carrying a net electric charge from losing or gaining electrons.

CAN.definition: To be able to; to have the ability, power, or permission to do something.

COIN.gloss: a flat piece of metal money
COIN.definition: A flat, typically round piece of metal used as money.

COIL.gloss: a length of something wound in loops
COIL.definition: A length of rope, wire, or other flexible material wound into a series of loops.

ICON.definition: A person or thing regarded as a representative symbol; also a small graphic on a screen.

CLAN.definition: A group of families or households united by descent from a common ancestor.

COLA.definition: A carbonated soft drink flavored with extract from the kola nut.

LOAN.definition: A thing that is borrowed, especially a sum of money expected to be paid back.

OIL.gloss: a slippery liquid that does not mix with water
OIL.definition: A viscous liquid derived from petroleum, plants, or animals, insoluble in water.

CON.definition: To persuade someone to do or believe something by deception.

NIL.definition: Nothing; zero, especially as a score in a game.
